metadata.description: Memory you can verify: a trust layer between an agent and its own past. Per-hit staleness verdicts, claim-level use attribution, a signed store that shows how each record arrived, episodic run-state. Local-first, no cloud.

plugins.name: bettermemory
plugins.description: Verification-grade memory for Claude Code. Every retrieved fact carries a staleness verdict (calendar age, filesystem path drift, git commit drift) so the model knows when a stored memory has rotted before relying on it, and a provenance label read off a signed, hash-chained log so a record planted around the tool reads unaccounted on the next search. Retrievals are logged with three attribution tiers (model-explicit with claim-level excerpts, Stop-hook match, or auto-fallback) so a reply months later can be traced back to the load-bearing stored claim. The store is one SQLite file in ~/.claude-memory/; retrieval is opt-in per turn, with a score-gated recall hook injecting a single stored pointer on the few prompts the silent-miss probe flags; claims about you commit labelled as inferences. An episode journal gives /loop iterations and subagent handoffs a home for run-state the durability gate rejects. Bundles nine MCP tools (memory_search, memory_show, memory_write, memory_update, memory_remove, memory_verify, memory_record_use, episode and memory_admin) and a memory-discipline skill that lands the policy in the system prompt.
